docs.title: Welcome to neo-apoli's documentation!
docs.text:
This page contains the surface level information regarding the mod, how it works, and what it provides for users to make data packs with.

neo-apoli is a rewrite of the Apoli mod by Apace, which provides an API for providing "powers" to entities via data packs.

docs.title: General information
docs.text:
• neo-apoli provides a context-based system to allow certain types, such as actions and conditions, to interconnect with powers in a dynamic manner. This also allows for features like "value providers," which are types that can provide a dynamic value (e.g: an entity's health as a value for a field).
  • Apoli and neo-apoli aren't compatible with each other due to how different their codebases are, so make sure that you create a new world/server.

docs.title: Action
docs.text:
Actions are used to operate on a given context. Actions can change or affect the world and/or its entities depending on the specified type.

Custom actions can be defined as JSON/JSON5/JSONC files in the data/<namespace>/neo-apoli/action directory of a data pack. Data packs that load later with an action file with the same name and directory will replace the existing action.

Note

Some actions require certain context parameters to function properly. Make sure to check the page for the desired action type for more information.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description type Identifier The identifier of the desired action type. Tip

Specifying certain data types will implicitly use a specific type:

Data Type Action Type Array of Actions sequence Empty Object ({}) nothing

docs.title: Add Velocity
docs.text:
Adds velocity to an entity.

Type ID: neo-apoli:add_velocity

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description method Method Determines the method of adding velocity to an entity. velocity Vec3 Provider The velocity to add to the entity. Method

A string that determines how velocity is applied to an entity. Each type has additional fields to further control how the velocity is applied.

singlepair Field Type Default Description space Space "world" Determines how the velocity will be transformed. entity Entity Provider The entity to add the velocity to. Field Type Default Description reference Reference "rotation" Determines the direction of the velocity is calculated from the two entities. first Entity Provider The entity to use as a reference. second Entity Provider The entity to add the velocity to.

Reference

A string that determines how the velocity will be transformed based on two entities.

docs.title: Values
docs.text: Value Description position Use the positions of the first and second entities to transform the velocity. rotation Use the rotation of the first entity to transform the velocity.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
SinglePair 
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:add_velocity",
    "method": "single",
    "space": "world",
    "entity": "this",
    "velocity": [
        0.0,
        10.0,
        0.0
    ]
}

This example will launch the entity from the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter high in the air.

{
    "type": "neo-apoli:add_velocity",
    "method": "pair",
    "reference": "rotation",
    "first": "actor",
    "second": "target",
    "velocity": [
        0.0,
        0.0,
        -2.0
    ]
}

This example will essentially pull the entity from the neo-apoli:target_entity context parameter to the entity from the neo-apoli:actor_entity context parameter.

docs.title: Apply Effects
docs.text:
Apply status effects to an entity.

Type ID: neo-apoli:apply_effects

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description effects Array of Effect Providers The status effects to apply to the entity. entity Entity Provider The entity to apply the status effects to.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:apply_effects",
    "effects": [
        {
            "id": "minecraft:regeneration",
            "amplifier": 1,
            "duration": 100
        }
    ],
    "entity": "this"
}

This example will apply the Regeneration II (00:05) status effect to the entity from the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter.

docs.title: Area of Effect
docs.text:
Executes an action on targets within the radius of an area.

Type ID: neo-apoli:area_of_effect

Info

This type will provide the following context parameters to the area_condition and area_action fields when checking for targets and executing if fulfilled depending on the specified area_target:

entityblock Parameter Description neo-apoli:entity_in_area The affected entity in the specified area. Parameter Description neo-apoli:block_in_area The affected block in the specified area.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description area_target Area Target Determines what kind of target is affected by the area. area_action Action The action to execute on the targets. area_condition Condition optional If specified, this condition is checked on each target before executing the area_action. position Vec3 Provider The position of the area. shape Shape "cube" The shape of the area. radius Float Provider The radius of the area. Area target

A string that determines what kind of target is affected by an area.

docs.title: Values
docs.text: Value Description entity The area will affect entities within it. block The area will affect blocks within it.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:area_of_effect",
    "area_target": "entity",
    "area_action": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:set_entity_on_fire",
        "ticks": 200,
        "entity": "entity_in_area"
    },
    "area_condition": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:is_entity_of_type",
        "entity_type": "minecraft:creeper",
        "entity": "entity_in_area"
    },
    "position": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:entity/position",
        "entity": "this"
    },
    "radius": 16.0
}

This example will set entities within a 16.0 blocks cubical area on fire relative to the entity provided by the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter.

docs.title: Bone Meal
docs.text:
Applies bone meal to blocks on a position.

Type ID: neo-apoli:bone_meal

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description position Vec3 Provider The position to apply a bone meal to. show_effects Boolean Provider true Determines whether to show the particle effects when bone meal is applied. offset_direction Direction Provider optional If specified, bone meal will be applied to the block at the position offset by this direction if the initial bone meal application failed.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:bone_meal",
    "position": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:block/position",
        "block": "used_block"
    },
    "offset_direction": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:context",
        "parameter": "used_side"
    }
}

This example will attempt to apply bone meal to the block provided by the neo-apoli:used_block context parameter. If it fails, it will apply the bone meal at the block offset by the direction provided by the neo-apoli:used_side context parameter instead.

docs.title: Clear Powers
docs.text:
Clears the powers of an entity.

Type ID: neo-apoli:clear_powers

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description entity Entity Provider The entity to clear the powers of.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:clear_powers",
    "entity": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:weighted",
        "entries": [
            {
                "value": "actor",
                "weight": 1
            },
            {
                "value": "target",
                "weight": 1
            }
        ]
    }
}

This example will clear the powers of one out of two entities picked at random with $50\%$ chance each:

  • the entity provided by the neo-apoli:actor_entity context parameter.
  • the entity provided by the neo-apoli:target_entity context parameter.

docs.title: Conditional
docs.text:
Executes the respective action if the specified condition is fulfilled or not.

Type ID: neo-apoli:conditional

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description condition Condition The condition to check. on_true Action optional If specified, this action will be executed if the condition returns true. on_false Action optional If specified, this action will be executed if the condition returns false.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:conditional",
    "condition": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:is_entity_of_type",
        "entity_type": "minecraft:creeper",
        "entity": "target"
    },
    "on_true": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:execute_command",
        "source": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:entity",
            "entity": "target"
        },
        "command": "summon lightning_bolt"
    }
}

This example will summon a lightning bolt at the entity referenced by the neo-apoli:target_entity context parameter if it's a creeper.

docs.title: History
docs.text: Minecraft Mod Changelog 1.21.5 0.1.0 Added the type.

docs.title: Conditional Composite
docs.text:
Executes the action of an entry whose condition is fulfilled, or executes the specified default action if no entries matched.

Type ID: neo-apoli:conditional/composite

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description entries Array of Entries The pairs of action and condition to check and execute. default Action optional If specified, this action will be executed if none of the specified entries were executed. Entry

An object that contains the condition to check and the action to execute.

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description condition Condition The condition to check. action Action The action to execute if the condition is fulfilled.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:conditional/composite",
    "entries": [
        {
            "condition": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:is_entity_sneaking",
                "entity": "this"
            },
            "action": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:set_entity_on_fire",
                "entity": "this",
                "ticks": 200
            }
        },
        {
            "condition": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:is_entity_climbing",
                "entity": "this"
            },
            "action": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:explode",
                "block_interaction": "destroy",
                "power": 8.0,
                "position": {
                    "type": "neo-apoli:entity/position",
                    "entity": "this"
                }
            }
        }
    ],
    "default": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:execute_command",
        "source": "server",
        "command": "tellraw @a {\"text\": \"None of the entries matched!\", \"color\": \"gray\", \"italic\": true}"
    }
}

This example has two entries: the entity will be set on fire for 5 seconds if they're sneaking, and the entity will explode (with an explosion that has a power of 8 and destroys blocks) if they're climbing.

docs.title: Consume Item
docs.text:
Reduces the count of an item.

Type ID: neo-apoli:consume_item

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description amount Int Provider 1 The amount to subtract from the item's count. slot Slot Provider The slot of the item to consume.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:consume_item",
    "slot": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:entity",
        "entity": "this",
        "slot": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:slot_id",
            "slot": "hotbar.0"
        }
    }
}

This example will consume the item from the first hotbar slot of the entity provided by the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter.

docs.title: Damage Entity
docs.text:
Deals damage to an entity.

Type ID: neo-apoli:damage_entity

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description damage_type Identifier The ID of the damage type to use. amount Float Provider The amount of damage to deal. victim Entity Provider The entity that will be damaged. attacker Entity Provider optional If specified, this entity will be considered as the source of the damage.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:damage_entity",
    "damage_type": "minecraft:magic",
    "amount": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:random/uniform",
        "min": 1.0,
        "max": 8.0
    },
    "victim": "target",
    "attacker": "actor"
}

This example will deal a random amount (ranging from $1.0$ to $8.0$) of damage to the entity provided by the neo-apoli:target_entity context parameter, making the entity provided by the neo-apoli:actor_entity context parameter as the source of the damage.

docs.text: Minecraft Mod Changelog 1.21.5 0.1.0 Added the type.

docs.title: Damage Item
docs.text:
Deals damage to an item.

Type ID: neo-apoli:damage_item

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description amount Int Provider 1 The amount of damage to deal. slot Slot Provider The slot of the item to damage. ignore_enchantments Boolean Provider false Determines whether enchantments (that can process changes in an item's durability) are ignored. item_holder Entity Provider optional If specified, this player will be used as the holder of the item. Info

The item_holder is mostly used for the following scenarios when damaging an item:

  • If the player is present and has infinite materials (e.g: in creative mode), the item will not be damaged.
  • if the player is present, the minecraft:item_durability_changed advancement criterion trigger is invoked.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:damage_item",
    "amount": 4,
    "slot": "used_item_slot",
    "item_holder": "this"
}

This example will deal 4 damage to the item provided by the neo-apoli:used_item_slot context parameter.

docs.title: Dismount
docs.text:
Dismounts an entity.

Type ID: neo-apoli:dismount

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description entity Entity Provider The entity to dismount.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:dismount",
    "entity": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:selector",
        "selector": "@e[sort = random, limit = 1]"
    }
}

This example will dismount a random entity from the world.

docs.title: Emit Game Event
docs.text:
Emits a game event at a position.

Type ID: neo-apoli:emit_game_event

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description game_event Identifier The ID of the game event to emit. position Vec3 Provider The position where to emit the game event. entity_source Entity Provider optional If specified, this entity will be considered as the entity that emitted the game event. block_source Block Provider optional If specified, this block will be considered as the block that emitted the game event.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:emit_game_event",
    "game_event": "minecraft:projectile_land",
    "position": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:block/position",
        "block": "used_block"
    },
    "entity_source": "this",
    "block_source": "used_block"
}

This example will emit a minecraft:projectile_land game event (which has a frequency of $2$) at the position of the block provided by the neo-apoli:used_block context parameter, making the same block and the entity provided by the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter as the block and entity (respectively) that emitted the game event.

docs.title: Execute Command
docs.text:
Executes a command.

Type ID: neo-apoli:execute_command

Warning

This type is server-side only.

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description source Command Source Provider The command source to use for executing the command. command String Provider The command to execute.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:execute_command",
    "source": "server",
    "command": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:weighted",
        "entries": [
            {
                "value": "say Hello world!",
                "weight": 1
            },
            {
                "value": "execute at @e run summon lightning_bolt",
                "weight": 1
            },
            {
                "type": "give @a diamond",
                "weight": 1
            }
        ]
    }
}

This example will execute one of the three commands picked at random with $33.33...\%$ chance each:

  • The server will output "Hello world!"
  • A lightning bolt will be summoned at all entities currently loaded.
  • All players will be given a diamond.

Type ID: neo-apoli:exhaust

docs.title: Explode
docs.text:
Emits an explosion at a position.

Type ID: neo-apoli:explode

Info

This type provides the following context parameters to certain fields:

destructible_conditiondamageable_conditionknockback_multiplier Parameter Description neo-apoli:exploded_block The block affected by the explosion. Parameter Description neo-apoli:emitter_entity The entity that emitted the explosion, or none if the emitter field is not present. neo-apoli:exploded_entity The entity affected by the explosion. Parameter Description neo-apoli:emitter_entity The entity that emitted the explosion, or none if the emitter field is not present. neo-apoli:exploded_entity The entity affected by the explosion.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description damageable_condition Condition optional If specified, determines which entities can be damaged. destructible_condition Condition optional If specified, determines which blocks can be destroyed. sound Sound Event "minecraft:entity.generic.explode" The sound to play for the explosion. small_particle Particle Effect "minecraft:explosion" The particle to emit if the explosion is small. large_particle Particle Effect "minecraft:explosion_emitter" The particle to emit if the explosion is large. block_interaction Block Interaction Determines how the explosion will interact with the affected blocks. power Float Provider Determines the power/radius of the explosion. knockback_multiplier Float Provider 1.0 Determines the knockback multiplier received by the affected entities. create_fire Boolean Provider true Determines whether fire should be placed within the affected area of the explosion. position Vec3 Provider The position of the explosion. emitter Entity Provider optional If specified, this entity will be considered the one that emitted the explosion. Explosion sizes

An explosion is considered small if its power is $\lt 2.0$ or if its block_interaction is not "keep".

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:explode",
    "damageable_condition": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:is_entity_of_type",
        "entity_type": "minecraft:creeper",
        "entity": "exploded_entity"
    },
    "block_interaction": "keep",
    "power": 16.0,
    "position": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:block/position",
        "block": "broken_block"
    },
    "emitter": "this"
}

This example will emit an explosion with a power/radius of $16.0$ which only damages creepers at the position of the block provided by the neo-apoli:broken_block context parameter, with the entity provided by the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter being the entity that emitted the explosion.

docs.title: Give Items
docs.text:
Gives item stacks to an entity.

Type ID: neo-apoli:give_items

Info

This type provides the following context parameters to the give_action field:

Parameter Description neo-apoli:given_slot The slot for the given item stack. neo-apoli:given_item The item stack given to the entity. Logic for giving items

If an indexed item has a specified slot, and the item stack couldn't be placed into the slot, it will be inserted into any available slots in the entity's inventory. If the item stack still couldn't be inserted into the entity's inventory, it will be dropped.

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description give_action Action optional If specified, this action will be executed for every item given to the entity. stacks Array of Indexed Stacks The item stacks to give to the entity. entity Entity Provider The entity to give the item stacks to.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:give_items",
    "stacks": [
        {
            "slot": "hotbar.0",
            "id": "minecraft:wooden_sword"
        },
        {
            "slot": "hotbar.1",
            "id": "minecraft:wooden_pickaxe"
        },
        {
            "id": "minecraft:shield"
        }
    ],
    "entity": "this"
}

This example will give the following items to the entity provided by the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter:

  • A wooden sword placed into the entity's first hotbar slot.
  • A wooden pickaxe placed into the entity's second hotbar slot.
  • A shield.

docs.title: Grant Power
docs.text:
Grants a power or a collection of powers to an entity.

Type ID: neo-apoli:grant_power

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description power Power Identifier or Power Tag The ID or tag of the power(s) to grant. source Identifier Indicates where the power is from. entity Entity Provider The entity to grant the power(s) to.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:grant_power",
    "power": "#example:all_the_good_stuff"/*(1)!*/,
    "source": "example:epic_stuff",
    "entity": "this"
}
  1. The location of the file is data/example/tags/neo-apoli/power/all_the_good_stuff.json

This example will grant all the powers included in the #example:all_the_good_stuff power tag to the entity provided by the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter with the source example:epic_stuff.

docs.title: Loop
docs.text:
Executes an action at the specified amount of times in a single tick.

Type ID: neo-apoli:loop

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description before_action Action optional If specified, this action will be executed before the loop starts. after_action Action optional If specified, this action will be executed after the loop completes. iterations Int Provider Determines the amount of times this action should be looped. action Action The action to execute for each iteration in the loop.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:loop",
    "iterations": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:random/uniform",
        "min": 0,
        "max": 10
    },
    "action": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:execute_command",
        "source": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:entity",
            "entity": "this"
        },
        "command": "say Hello!"
    }
}

This example makes the entity say "Hello!" a random amount of times (0 to 10 times).

docs.title: Modify Block State Property
docs.text:
Modifies the state property of a block.

Type ID: neo-apoli:modify_block_state_property

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description property String Provider The state property of the block to modify. block Block Provider The block to modify its state property of. value String Provider optional If specified, the value of the state property will be set to this value. cycle Boolean Provider optional If specified, the value of the state property will be cycled. Warning

Only one of value or cycle fields must be present! If both or none are present, an error will be thrown.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:modify_block_state_property",
    "property": "axis",
    "block": "used_block",
    "cycle": true
}

This example will cycle the axis state property of the block provided by the neo-apoli:used_block context parameter, essentially rotating the block.

docs.title: Modify Item
docs.text:
Applies an item modifier to an item stack.

Type ID: neo-apoli:modify_item

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description modifier Identifier The ID of the item modifier. slot Slot Provider The slot of the item that will be modified. position Vec3 Provider optional If specified, this position will be passed as the minecraft:origin vanilla context parameter for the item modifier. entity Entity Provider optional If specified, this entity will be used as the minecraft:this_entity vanilla context parameter for the item modifier.

docs.title: Place Block
docs.text:
Places a block at a position.

Type ID: neo-apoli:place_block

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description position Vec3 Provider The position of where the block would be placed. block Block State Argument The block to place. mode Mode "default" Determines how the block is placed. offset_direction Direction Provider optional If specified and if mode is "default", the position will be offset by this direction if the block couldn't be placed at the position. Mode

A string that determines how a block is placed at a position.

docs.title: Values
docs.text: Value Description destroy Before the new block is placed, the old block drops both itself and its contents, and the appropriate block breaking noise/particles are played/emitted. keep Places the block only if the position is not occupied by another block. replace Replace the old block with the new block; no items are dropped nor noise/particles are played/emitted. default Places the block at the position. If the position is occupied by another block, attempts to offset the position by a specific direction. strict Places the block as-is without triggering block and shape updates.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:place_block",
    "block": "minecraft:cobweb",
    "position": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:entity/position",
        "entity": "projectile"
    },
    "offset_direction": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:context",
        "parameter": "landed_on_side"
    }
}

This example will attempt to place a cobweb block at the position of the entity provided by the neo-apoli:projectile_entity context parameter.

If the block couldn't be placed, it will attempt to place the cobweb at the side of the block offset by the direction provided by the neo-apoli:landed_on_side context parameter.

docs.title: Weighted
docs.text:
Picks an entry at random and executes its action.

Type ID: neo-apoli:weighted

Note

The chance of an entry being picked is determined by dividing the weight of the entry to the sum of all the entries' weights.$(Chance = Weight_e \div (Weight_1 + Weight_2 + ... + Weight_n))$

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description entries Array of Weighted Entries The entries to pick a random entry from. Weighted Entry

An object that contains an action and its weight.

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description action Action The action to execute. weight Integer The weight of the entry. The value must be either 0 or higher.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:weighted",
    "entries": [
        {
            "action": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:set_entity_on_fire",
                "ticks": 200,
                "entity": "this"
            },
            "weight": 5
        },
        {
            "action": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:apply_effects",
                "effects": [
                    {
                        "id": "minecraft:poison",
                        "duration": 200
                    }
                ],
                "entity": "this"
            },
            "weight": 3
        },
        {
            "action": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:apply_effects",
                "effects": [
                    {
                        "id": "minecraft:regeneration",
                        "duration": 200
                    }
                ],
                "entity": "this"
            },
            "weight": 1
        }
    ]
}

This example has three entries to pick from: an entry that has a 55% chance $(5 \div 9 = 0.55...)$ of setting the entity from the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter on fire for 5 seconds, an entry that has a 33% chance $(3 \div 9 = 0.33...)$ of applying a Poison I (00:10) status effect, and an entry that has an 11% chance $(1 \div 9 = 0.11...)$ of applying Regeneration I (00:10) status effect.

docs.title: Dynamic HSV
docs.text:
Provides an HSV (hue, saturation, value/brightness/lightness) color (which is then converted to ARGB) with float providers.

Type ID: neo-apoli:dynamic/hsv

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description hue Float Provider The hue component of the color. The value is clamped from 0.0 to 1.0. saturation Float Provider The saturation component of the color. The value is clamped from 0.0 to 1.0. value Float Provider The value/brightness/lightness component of the color. The value is clamped from 0.0 to 1.0. alpha Float Provider The alpha (transparency) component of the color. The value is clamped from 0.0 to 1.0.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:dynamic/hsv",
    "hue": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:quotient",
        "dividend": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:time",
            "period": 200
        },
        "divisor": 200
    },
    "saturation": 1.0,
    "value": 1.0
}

This example provides an HSV color with its hue component changing every tick, essentially making it cycle through every color.

docs.title: Dynamic RGBA
docs.text:
Provides an RGBA color (which is then converted to ARGB) using float providers.

Type ID: neo-apoli:dynamic/rgba

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description red Float Provider The red component of the color. The value is clamped from 0.0 to 1.0. green Float Provider The green component of the color. The value is clamped from 0.0 to 1.0. blue Float Provider The blue component of the color. The value is clamped from 0.0 to 1.0. alpha Float Provider The alpha (transparency) component of the color. The value is clamped from 0.0 to 1.0.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:dynamic/rgba",
    "red": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:linear_interpolated",
        "delta": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:product",
            "values": [
                {
                    "type": "neo-apoli:vector/length",
                    "vector": {
                        "type": "neo-apoli:entity/velocity",
                        "entity": "this"
                    }
                },
                3.5
            ]
        },
        "start": 1.0,
        "end": 0.0
    },
    "green": 1.0,
    "blue": 1.0,
    "alpha": 1.0
}

This example provides an RGBA color with its red component being dependent on the entity's velocity magnitude. The faster the entity's velocity, the less red it becomes.

docs.title: Comparison
docs.text:
Comparisons are data objects used to compare two comparable objects and return whether it passes or fails.

Some comparisons use a comparator, while others rely on the compared objects' equality.

Note

This is mainly used by the compare condition type.

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description type Identifier The identifier of the desired comparison type.

docs.title: Types
docs.text:
• entity

  • int
  • nbt

docs.title: Entity
docs.text:
Compares the IDs of the first and second entities.

Type ID: neo-apoli:entity

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description first Entity Provider The first entity to compare to. second Entity Provider The second entity to be compared.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:entity",
    "first": "actor",
    "second": "target"
}

This example compares the IDs of the entities from the neo-apoli:actor_entity and neo-apoli:target_entity context parameters.

docs.title: Float
docs.text:

Type ID: neo-apoli:float

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description comparator Comparator Determines how the floats are compared. first Float Provider The first float to compare to. second Float Provider The second float to be compared.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:

    "type": "neo-apoli:float",
    "comparator": "==",
    "first": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:power/cooldown/progress",
        "power": "example:cooldown",
        "entity": "this"
    },
    "second": 1.0
}

This example compares the cooldown progress of the example:cooldown power to 1.0, essentially checking if it's currently not in the progress of cooling down.

docs.title: NBT
docs.text:
Compares the elements (and its contents, if it's a list) of the first and second NBTs.

Type ID: neo-apoli:nbt

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description first NBT Provider The first NBT to compare to. second NBT Provider The second NBT to be compared.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:nbt",
    "first": {
        "Item": {
            "components": {
                "minecraft:custom_data": {
                    "example:data": {
                        "striker": true
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    },
    "second": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:entity",
        "entity": "projectile"
    }
}

This example compares the NBT of the entity from the neo-apoli:projectile_entity context parameter to the first NBT, essentially checking if the entity has an item that has the minecraft:custom_data item component that contains an example:data NBT compound with striker: 1b.

docs.title: String
docs.text:
Compares the first and second strings lexicographically(1).

  1. Lexicographical comparison means comparing two strings based on the order of their characters, similar to how words are arranged in a dictionary.

Type ID: neo-apoli:string

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description comparator Comparator Determines how the strings are compared lexicographically. first String Provider The first string to compare to. second String Provider The second string to be compared. case_sensitive Boolean Provider true Determines whether comparing the strings should be case-sensitive.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:int",
    "comparator": "<",
    "first": "abc",
    "second": "def"
}

This example checks if the first string is lexographically less than the second string (which is true.)

docs.title: Condition
docs.text:
Conditions are used to test against a given context, checking the provided information and return either a pass or fail.

Custom conditions can be defined as JSON/JSON5/JSONC files in the data/<namespace>/neo-apoli/condition directory of a data pack. Data packs that load later with a condition file with the same name and directory will replace the existing condition.

Note

Some conditions require certain context parameters to function properly. Make sure to check the page for the desired condition type for more information.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description type Identifier The identifier of the desired condition type. Tip

Specifying a boolean will implicitly use the constant condition type.

docs.title: Check Block Type
docs.text:

docs.text:

docs.title: Matches Block Pattern
docs.text:
Checks if a pattern of blocks is matched.

Type ID: neo-apoli:matches_block_pattern

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description pattern Nested Array of Strings Determines the pattern of blocks to match. where Key-Condition Map The map definition for the pattern. front_top_left Vec3 Provider The relative front top-left position to check the pattern. forwards Direction Provider The forwards direction used for checking the pattern. up Direction Provider The upwards direction used for checking the pattern. partial Boolean Provider false Determines whether this type should return true if any of the blocks in the pattern matched. Key-condition map

An object that defines the corresponding condition of a character in a pattern, similar to how the ingredients of a shaped recipe is defined.

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description <key> Condition Determines the corresponding condition for the character <key> for a pattern.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:

    "type": "neo-apoli:matches_block_pattern",
    "pattern": [
        [
            "###",
            "###",  // top
            "###"
        ],
        [
            "###",
            "#~#",
            "###"
        ],

        [
            "###",
            "#~#",
            "###"
        ],
        [
            "###",
            "###",  // bottom
            "###"
        ]
    ],
    "where": {
        "#": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:is_block_in_tag",
            "tag": "#minecraft:planks",
            "block": "matching_block"
        },
        "~": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:is_block_of_type",
            "block_type": "minecraft:water",
            "block": "matching_block"
        }
    },
    "front_top_left": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:offset",
        "vector": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:entity/position",
            "entity": "this"
        },
        "offset": [
            1.0,
            0.0,
            1.0
        ]
    },
    "forwards": "down",
    "up": "south"
}

This example will check if the entity provided by the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter is standing on top center of a tank-like structure made up of any wood planks filled with water.

docs.title: Provide Context
docs.text:
Invokes a condition with the provided context parameters.

docs.text: Field Type Default Description condition Condition The condition to invoke. parameters Context Parameter Map The context parameters to provide.

    "parameters": {

            "value": "worn_item"
        },
        "example:threshold": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:float",
            "value": 2.0
        }
    }
}

  1. The location of the file is data/example/neo-apoli/condition/item/is_armor_higher_than_threshold.json with this as its contents:

    {
    "type": "neo-apoli:compare",
    "comparison": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:float",
        "comparator": ">",
        "first": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:item/attribute",
            "attribute": "minecraft:armor",
            "item": "example:item"
        },
        "second": "example:threshold"
    }
}

This example will invoke the example:item/is_armor_higher_than_threshold condition, provide the context parameters that it uses, and uses its result.

docs.title: Attributed Modifier
docs.text: An object that contains an attribute and its modifier.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description attribute Identifier The identifier of the attribute to modify. id Identifier The identifier of the modifier. This can be arbitrary. amount Float The amount of the modifier. operation String Determines how the modifier modifies the value. Info

Attributed modifiers are performed in the following order:

Operation Description add_value Adds all of the modifiers' amounts to the base value of the attribute.$(Total = Base + Amount_1 + Amount_2 + ... + Amount_n)$ add_multiplied_base Multiplies the base value of the attribute by (1 + sum of modifiers' amounts.)$(Total = Base * (1 + Amount_1 + Amount_2 + ... + Amount_n))$ add_multiplied_total Multiplies the base value of the attribute by (1 + modifiers' amounts) for every modifier.$(Total = Base * (1 + Amount_1) * (1 + Amount_2) * ... * (1 + Amount_n))$

docs.title: Example
Axis
docs.text: A string that refers to a coordinate axis of a three-dimensional plane.

docs.title: Values
docs.text: Values Description x Refers to east or west in the positive or negative direction respectively. y Refers to up or down in the positive or negative direction respectively. z Refers to south and north in the positive or negative direction respectively.

docs.title: Block Interaction
docs.text: A string that determines how an explosion interacts with its affected blocks.

docs.title: Values
docs.text: Value Description keep Determines that the explosion will not destroy or trigger any of the affected blocks. destroy Determines that the explosion will destroy the affected blocks. destroy_with_decay Determines that the explosion will destroy the affected blocks with its radius passed as a parameter for loot tables. trigger_block Determines that the explosion will trigger the affected blocks.

docs.title: Block Use Phase
docs.text:
A string that indicates the phase of which the player is using a block.

Note

With the way Minecraft's block interaction system works, it will first check if the block has an interaction result when interacted with an item (block_with_item). If the interaction result indicates a pass (allowing for other interactions to perform), it will then check if the block has an interaction result without an item (block)

docs.title: Values
docs.text: Phase Description block_with_item Indicates that the interaction of a block is with an item. block Indicates that the interaction of a block.

docs.title: Comparator
docs.text: A string that indicates how a two comparable objects should be compared.

docs.title: Values
docs.text: Value Description == Checks if the first object is equal to the second object. != Checks if the first object is not equal to the second object. > Checks if the first object is greater than the second object. >= Checks if the first object is greater or equal to the second object. < Checks if the first object is less than the second object. <= Checks if the first object is less than or equal to the second object.

docs.title: Context Parameter
docs.text: An object that determines a parameter, which indicates what kind of object is stored in a context.

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description type Type The ID of the desired parameter type. name Identifier The ID of the parameter.

docs.title: Types
docs.text:
Most if not all parameter types have a corresponding value provider. Check the table below for the available parameter types and its corresponding value provider:

Type Value Provider neo-apoli:block Block Provider neo-apoli:boolean Boolean Provider neo-apoli:box Box Provider neo-apoli:command_source Command Source Provider neo-apoli:damage_source Damage Source Provider neo-apoli:direction Direction Provider neo-apoli:effect Effect Provider neo-apoli:entity Entity Provider neo-apoli:float Float Provider neo-apoli:int Int Provider neo-apoli:item Item Provider neo-apoli:nbt NBT Provider neo-apoli:slot Slot Provider neo-apoli:string String Provider neo-apoli:vec3 Vec3 Provider

docs.title: Pre-defined Parameters
docs.text:
In neo-apoli, there are pre-defined context parameters that are used/shared by certain types:

Parameter Type Description neo-apoli:command/entity neo-apoli:entity Refers to the entity that executed the command. neo-apoli:command/position neo-apoli:vec3 Refers to the position of the executed command. neo-apoli:actor_entity neo-apoli:entity Usually refers to an entity that did an action. (e.g: the attacker) neo-apoli:target_entity neo-apoli:entity Usually refers to the entity that was targeted. (e.g: the victim) neo-apoli:projectile_entity neo-apoli:entity Refers to a projectile entity. neo-apoli:this_entity neo-apoli:entity Usually refers to the entity holding a power. neo-apoli:dealt_damage_source neo-apoli:damage_source The damage source dealt by an entity. neo-apoli:taken_damage_source neo-apoli:damage_source The damage source taken by an entity. neo-apoli:damaging_entity neo-apoli:entity The projectile used for the attack (or the attacker entity if no projectiles were used.) neo-apoli:direct_damaging_entity neo-apoli:entity The owner of the projectile used for the attack (or the attacker entity if no projectiles were used.) neo-apoli:broken_block neo-apoli:block The block that was broken by a player. neo-apoli:broken_side neo-apoli:direction The side of the block broken by a player. neo-apoli:mining_block neo-apoli:block The block being mined by a player. neo-apoli:selected_block neo-apoli:block The block the player is looking at. neo-apoli:applied_effect The applied status effect to an entity. neo-apoli:item_in_container neo-apoli:item The item stack from a container. neo-apoli:item_in_container_slot neo-apoli:slot The slot of the item stack from a container. neo-apoli:used_item neo-apoli:item The item stack used by an entity. neo-apoli:used_item_slot neo-apoli:slot The slot of the item stack used by an entity.

docs.title: Context Parameter Map
docs.text: An object that contains a key-value pair where the keys are the names of the context parameters and its values being the type of context parameter and its corresponding value provider.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description <name> Entry The context parameter to provide. The <name> will be the ID of the context parameter and it can be arbitrary as long as it follows the rules of identifiers. Entry

An object that defines a context parameter and its value.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description type Context Parameter Type The ID of the desired parameter type. value Value Provider The value provider that'd provide the value for the parameter. Tip

Make sure to click on the hyperlink for context parameter types to see the corresponding value provider to use for your desired type.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "example:random_int": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:int",
        "value": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:random/uniform",
            "min": 1,
            "max": 64
        }
    },
    "example:held_entity": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:entity",
        "value": "this"
    }
}

This example provides a context parameter map that has two context parameters: example:random_int which refers to a random integer from 1 to 64, and example:held_entity which refers to the entity from the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter.

docs.text: An object that contains a recipe and its identifier.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description id Identifier The identifier of the recipe. type Identifier The identifier for the type of the desired crafting recipe. Tip

See Recipe (JSON format) for more information regarding recipe types provided by vanilla. Please note that this specific data type will only accept crafting variants.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "id": "example:epic_sword",
    "type": "minecraft:crafting_shaped",
    "pattern": [
        "I",
        "I",
        "S"
    ],
    "key": {
        "I": "minecraft:iron_block",
        "S": "minecraft:stick"
    },
    "result": {
        "id": "minecraft:iron_sword",
        "components": {

docs.text: Value Description up Rounds the value away from zero, where the digit prior to a non-zero value is incremented. down Rounds the value towards zero, where the float is truncated to the specified decimal places. ceiling Rounds the value towards positive infinity. If the value is positive, it behaves like up and if it's negative, it behaves like down. floor Rounds the value towards negative infinity. If the value is positive, it behaves like down and if it's negative, it behaves like up. half_up Rounds the value towards the "nearest neighbor" unless both neighbors are equidistant, in which case, it'll be rounded up.Behaves like up if the digit is $\gtrapprox 0.5$, otherwise, it behaves like down. half_down Rounds the value towards the "nearest neighbor" unless both neighbors are equidistant, in which case, it'll be rounded down.Behaves like up if the digit is $\gt 0.5$, otherwise, it behaves like down. half_even Rounds the value towards the "nearest neighbor" unless both neighbors are equidistant, in which case, it'll round towards the even neighbor.Behaves like half_up if the digit to the left is odd, otherwise, it behaves like half_down if it's even.

docs.title: Space
docs.text: A string that determines how a 3-vector is transformed for an entity.

docs.title: Values
docs.text: Value Description world The axes are not transformed and is relative to the world's coordinates where X points to the west/east (negative/positive), Y points to the bottom/top (negative/positive), and the Z points to the north/south. (negative/positive) local The axes are transformed to be relative to the entity's orientation where X points to its left, Y points upwards relative to where the entity is facing, and Z points to where the entity is facing. local_horizontal Same as local except it considers the vertical orientation to be zero, resulting in Z being projected (flattened out) onto the horizontal plane, making it shorter. X and Y also become shorter by the same amount and Y will always point upwards.The axes shrink as the direction the entity is facing diverges from being horizontal. (e.g: if the entity is looking straight up/down, the axes will have zero length, akin to forcing the X, Y, and Z to be zero) local_horizontal_normalized Same as local_horizontal except the axes are normalized, where the axes' length are set back to its previous length of 1 if it's of a non-zero length. velocity The axes are transformed to be relative to the entity's velocity, similar to local. If the velocity is purely vertical, the direction the entity is facing is used to determine the direction of X and Y instead of the velocity.The axes scale based on how fast the entity is moving. (e.g: if the entity is not moving, the axes will have zero length, akin to forcing the X, Y, and Z to be zero) velocity_normalized Same as velocity except the vertical velocity is considered to be 0. velocity_horizontal_normalized Same as velocity_horizontal except the axes are normalized, where the axes' length are set back to its previous length of 1 if it's of a non-zero length.

docs.title: Overlay Nausea
docs.text:
Overlays a texture sprite on the screen of the player, with the alpha component of the color being the intensity of the color and stretch factor of the texture.

Type ID: neo-apoli:overlay/nausea

Info

This HUD element type blends the colors to the texture additively. It also treats black pixels in the texture as transparent.

Tip

Custom overlay textures must be placed in the assets/<namespace>/textures/overlay/sprites directory of a resource pack to be recognized and used properly.

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description sprite Sprite or Identifier The sprite definition or ID of the overlay to render. If an ID is specified, it will implicitly use the neo-apoli:textures/atlas/overlay.png atlas. color Color optional The color to blend to the colors of the texture sprite. render_phase Render Phase Determines when the overlay should be rendered. should_render Boolean Provider true Determines whether the overlay should render. hide_with_hud Boolean Provider true Determines whether the overlay should hide alongside the HUD. (e.g: when pressing F1) visible_in_third_person Boolean Provider true Determines whether the overlay should be visible when in third person.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:overlay/nausea",
    "sprite": "example:nausea_overlay"/*(1)!*/,
    "color": "#32c5ff9d",
    "render_phase": "below_hud",
    "hide_with_hud": false
}

This example renders a light blue and slightly transparent overlay that doesn't hide when the HUD is hidden.

  1. The location for the texture file in a resource pack is assets/example/textures/overlay/sprites/nausea_overlay.png

docs.title: Resource Bar
docs.text:
Renders a bar above the hunger status bar on the HUD.

Info

This HUD element type uses the following context parameters. The following fields must, or must not be present, depending on whether the context parameters are provided:

Parameter Field neo-apoli:hud/value value neo-apoli:hud/max_value max neo-apoli:hud/min_value min

docs.title: Modifier
docs.text: Modifiers are objects used to specify how a floating point value is modified.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description type Identifier The identifier of the desired modifier type. phase Phase Determines when the modifier will be applied. modifiers Array of Modifiers optional If specified, these modifiers will be applied first before the this modifier is applied. amount Float Provider The amount of the modifier. Phase

Modifiers are applied in the following order:

Phase Description base Determines that the base value will be modified. This is the first phase where the total value is equal to the base value. total Determines that the total value will be modified.

docs.title: Types
docs.text:
Note

Modifiers are applied in the order they're listed below, with add being applied first and set being applied last.

Type Description add Adds all of the modifiers' amounts to the value.$(Total = Amount_1 + Amount_2 + ... + Amount_n)$ multiply Multiplies the modifiers' amounts to the value.$(Total = Amount_1 * Amount_2 + ... + Amount_n)$ multiply_additive Multiplies the base value by (1 + sum of modifiers' amounts.)$(Total = Base * (1 + Amount_1 + Amount_2 + ... + Amount_n))$ multiply_multiplicative Multiplies the base value by (1 + modifiers' amount) for every modifier.$(Total = Base * (1 + Amount_1) * (1 + Amount_2) * ... * (1 + Amount_n))$ divide Divides the value to all of the modifiers' amounts.$(Total = Amount_1 \div Amount_2 \div ... \div Amount_3)$ min Returns the minimum value of all the modifiers' amounts.$(Total = \argmin f(Amount_n))$ max Returns the maximum value of all the modifiers' amounts.$(Total = \argmax f(Amount_n))$ set Uses the modifier's value as the new total value.$(Total = Amount_n)$

docs.title: Power
docs.text:
Powers give a certain "ability" to the entity it's granted to. The functionality of the "ability" will depend on the specified type.

Custom powers can be defined as JSON/JSON5/JSONC files in the data/<namespace>/neo-apoli/power directory of a data pack. Data packs that load later with a power file with the same name and directory will replace the existing power.

Powers providing context

Power types provide the context used by other context-based data objects, such as actions and conditions, for flexibility.(1) Some power types may provide more context parameters, so make sure to check the corresponding pages for your desired power type.

  1. The neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter is also automatically provided, which refers to the entity holding the power.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description type Identifier The identifier of the desired power type. name Text Component optional The display name of the power, prioritizing translations from resource packs. If unspecified, a translatable name with the key power.<namespace>.<path>.name is provided. description Text Component optional The display description of the power, prioritizing translations from resource packs. If unspecified, a translatable name with the key power.<namespace>.<path>.description is provided. hidden Boolean false Determines whether the power should be hidden. Powers and its active_condition

A power, unless stated otherwise by its type, supports an optional active_condition field which determines whether the power is considered active. If the field is absent, the power will be considered as always active.

docs.title: Callback Block Break
docs.text:
Invokes an action upon the player breaking a block.

Type ID: neo-apoli:callback/block/break

Info

This type provides the following context parameters:

Parameter Description neo-apoli:broken_block The block broken by the player. neo-apoli:broken_side The side at which the player broke the block.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description on_break_action Action The action to invoke when a block is broken. only_when_harvested Boolean Provider false Determines whether the action should only be invoked when the block is broken with its correct tool. priority Integer 0 Determines the order of which powers of this type will be iterated. About priorities

The instances of this type will be sorted in its reversed natural order meaning that instances that have a higher priority value will be executed first before those that have lower priority values.

        "entity": "this"
    },
    "active_condition": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:is_block_of_type",
        "block_type": "minecraft:magma_block",
        "block": "broken_block"
    }
 }

docs.title: Modify Block Use
docs.text:
Modifies the interaction of a block.

Type ID: neo-apoli:modify/block/use

Info

This type provides the following context parameters:

Parameter Description neo-apoli:used_block The block which the player interacted with. neo-apoli:used_side The side of the block the player interacted with. neo-apoli:used_item_slot The item slot used for interacting with the player. neo-apoli:used_item The item stack used for interacting with the player.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description action Action optional If specified, this action will be executed when the player interacts with a block. result Interaction Result "success" Determines the result of the player's interaction with a block. directions Array of Directions ["down", "up", "north", "south", "west", "east"] Determines whether to trigger instances of this type when the player interacts with the specified sides of a block. hands Array of Hands ["main_hand", "off_hand"] Determines whether to trigger instances of this type when the player interacts with a block with the specified hands. use_phases Array of Block Use Phases ["block", "block_with_item"] Determines whether to trigger instances of this type when the player's interaction with a block enters the specified phases. priority Integer 0 Determines the order of which instances of this type is checked and executed. About priorities

The instances of this type will be sorted in its reversed natural order meaning that instances that have a higher priority value will be checked and executed first before those that have lower priority values.

This instance also has specific rules with specific values of priorities:

  • If the priority value is equal or greater than 1, the instance will be executed and override the result of the interaction.
  • If the priority value is equal or less than -1, the instance will only be executed if the previous interaction result is a pass.
  • If the priority value is equal to 0, the instance will be executed and will not override the end result.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:modify/block/use",
    "action": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:execute_command",
        "source": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:entity",
            "entity": "this"
        },
        "command": "tellraw @s {\"text\": \"You cannot open chests made of copper!\", \"color\": \"red\"}"
    },
    "result": "fail",
    "priority": 1,
    "active_condition": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:is_block_in_tag",
        "tag": "#minecraft:copper_chests",
        "block": "used_block"
    }
}

docs.title: Modify Item Use
docs.text:
Modifies the interaction of an item.

Type ID: neo-apoli:modify/item/use

Info

This type provides the following context parameters:

Parameter Description neo-apoli:used_item_slot The slot of the item used by the player. neo-apoli:used_item The item used by the player.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description on_use_action Action The action to execute when the player interacts with an item. result Interaction Result success Determines the result of the player's interaction with an item. hands Array of Hands ["main_hand", "off_hand"] Determines whether to trigger instances of this type when the player interacts with an item with the specified hands. trigger_type String Determines when instances of this type should be triggered. priority Integer 0 Determines the order of which instances of this type is checked and executed. About priorities

The instances of this type will be sorted in its reversed natural order meaning that instances that have a higher priority value will be checked and executed first before those that have lower priority values.

Trigger types

Each item has specific "triggers" that indicates when a player is interacting with an item. The "triggers" are as follows:

Value Description instant The player interacted with an item that doesn't have a use duration but may have effects that are instantly triggered (e.g: thrown an ender pearl, a splash potion, or any throwable items.) start The player started interacting with an item that has a use duration. stop The player stopped interacting with an item that has a use duration. finish The player finished interacting with an item that has a use duration (e.g: finished consuming a consumable item, or finished charging a bow.) during The player is using an item with a use duration every tick (e.g: charging a bow.)

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:modify/item/use",
    "on_use_action": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:apply_effects",
        "effects": [
            {
                "id": "minecraft:regeneration",
                "duration": 200,
                "amplifier": 1,
                "show_icon": true
            }
        ],
        "entity": "this"
    },
    "trigger_type": "finish",
    "active_condition": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:item_matches_predicate",
        "predicate": "*[minecraft:food]",
        "item": "used_item"
    }
}

This example will give the player Regeneration II (00:05) after it consumes any item that has the minecraft:food item component.

docs.title: Multiple
docs.text:
Allows for defining powers in a single file.

Type ID: neo-apoli:multiple

Tip

Sub-powers can be referenced by using the @ character. (e.g: namespace:path/to/power@sub_power)

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Any fields (except type, name, description, hidden, fabric:load_conditions, or fields that starts with $) will be considered as a "sub-power."

Warning

This type does not support the active_condition field.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:multiple",
    "cooldown": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:cooldown",
        "hud_element": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:resource_bar"
        },
        "cooldown": 200
    },
    "trigger": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:callback/damage/dealt",
        "on_hit_action": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:trigger_power_cooldown",
            "power": "*:*@cooldown",
            "entity": "this"
        }
    },
    "epic_damage": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:modify/damage/dealt",
        "modifiers": [
            {
                "type": "neo-apoli:multiply_multiplicative",
                "phase": "total",
                "amount": 0.5
            }
        ],
        "active_condition": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:compare",
            "comparison": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:float",
                "comparator": "==",
                "first": {
                    "type": "neo-apoli:power/cooldown/progress",
                    "power": "*:*@cooldown",
                    "entity": "this"
                },
                "second": 1.0
            }
        }
    }
}

This example defines three sub-powers: cooldown which uses the neo-apoli:cooldown power type, trigger which uses the neo-apoli:callback/damage/dealt power type to trigger the cooldown sub-power when damage is dealt, and epic_damage which uses the modify/damage/dealt power type to deal 50% more damage when the cooldown of cooldown is not in progress.

docs.title: Replace Loot Table
docs.text:
Replaces a loot table with another loot table.

Type ID: neo-apoli:replace_loot_table

Info

This type provides the following context parameters depending on the type of the loot table:

BarterBlockChestEntityFishing Parameter Description neo-apoli:actor_entity The entity holding the power. neo-apoli:target_entity The Piglin that was bartered with. Parameter Description neo-apoli:actor_entity The entity holding the power. neo-apoli:block The block broken by the player. neo-apoli:tool_item The item used by the player for breaking a block. Parameter Description neo-apoli:actor_entity The entity holding the power. neo-apoli:target_entity The player that opened a chest block. neo-apoli:block The chest block opened by the player. Parameter Description neo-apoli:actor_entity The entity holding the power neo-apoli:target_entity The entity that died. neo-apoli:block The block at the position of the entity that died. Parameter Description neo-apoli:actor_entity The entity holding the power. neo-apoli:target_entity The fishing bobber of the entity holding the power. neo-apoli:block The block at the position of the fishing bobber. neo-apoli:tool_item The rod item used for fishing.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description replacements Replacement Map Determines which loot tables to replace with other loot tables. priority Integer 0 Determines the order of which powers of this type will be iterated. About priorities

The instances of this type will be sorted in its reversed natural order meaning that instances that have a higher priority value will be executed first before those that have lower priority values.

Replacement Map

The replacements field has the following format:

Field Type Default Description <key> String Determines the loot table to replace <key> with.

Note

<key> refers to a string formatted as a regular expression, where it will find loot tables where its ID matches the expression. See Wikipedia: Regular expression for more information and RegExr to test regular expressions online.

docs.text:
Provides the component (min/max values) of a box from a specific side.

Type ID: neo-apoli:box/component

Box components and sides

Each direction returns a specific component of a box:

Direction Component down The minimum Y component of the box. up The maximum Y component of the box. north The minimum Z component of the box. south The maximum Z component of the box. west The minimum X component of the box. east The maximum X component of the box.

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description box Box Provider The box to get its component of. side Direction Provider The side of the box to get the component from.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:box/component",
    "box": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:entity/bounds",
        "entity": "this"
    },
    "side": "up"
}

This example provides the maximum Y component of the bounding box of the entity (provided by the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter.)

docs.title: Box Size
docs.text:
Provides the size of a box.

Type ID: neo-apoli:box/size

Info

The size of the box is calculated by the following formula: $(Size = ((Max_x - Min_x) + (Max_y - Min_y) + (Max_z - Min_z)) \div 3.0)$

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description box Box Provider The box to get the size of.

    "type": "neo-apoli:box/size",
    "box": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:entity/bounds",
        "entity": "projectile"
    }
}

This example provides the size of the bounding box from the entity (provided by the neo-apoli:projectile_entity context parameter.)

docs.title: Linear Interpolated
docs.text:
Interpolates a float value.

Type ID: neo-apoli:linear_interpolated

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description delta Float Provider A float value that indicates the percentage of the interpolation. start Float Provider The start value for the interpolation. end Float Provider The end value of the interpolation. Info

If delta is $0$, it will provide the start value. If it's $1$, it will provide the end value. Otherwise, it'll be clamped to be within the range of $0.0$ to $1.0$.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:linear_interpolated",
    "delta": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:quotient",
        "dividend": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:entity/attribute",
            "attribute": "minecraft:armor",
            "entity": "this"
        },
        "divisor": 30.0
    },
    "start": 10.0,
    "end": 0.0
}

This example will provide a float value ranging from $10.0$ to $0.0$ depending on the quotient of the value of the minecraft:armor attribute (from the entity provided by the neo-apoli:this context parameter) divided by $30.0$.

For example, if the attribute has a value of $20.0$, the provided value will be $3.333333333333334$ $(10.0 + 20.0 * (0.0 - 10.0) = 3.333333333333334)$

docs.title: Vector Length
docs.text:
Provides the length of a vector.

Type ID: neo-apoli:vector/length

Info

The formula for calculating the length of a vector is as follows: $(Length = \sqrt{X * X + Y * Y + Z * Z})$

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description vector Vec3 Provider The vector to get the length of.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:vector/length",
    "vector": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:entity/position",
        "entity": "this"
    }
}

This example will provide the length of the position vector of an entity (provided by the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter.) For example, let's say the entity's position is X: $33.0$, Y: $87.0$, Z: $242.0$. The length of the position vector will be $259.2720578851489$.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{

    "condition": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:is_block_of_type",

        "block": "adjacent_block"
    },
    "position": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:block/position",
        "block": "used_block"
    }
}

This example counts how many blocks adjacent to a block (provided by the neo-apoli:used_block context parameter) is a Dirt block.

docs.title: Conditional
docs.text:
Provides the respective value if the specified condition is fulfilled or not.

Type ID: neo-apoli:conditional

Note

This meta type can only provide the same kind of value of the field where it was used. (e.g: if the field is a boolean provider, the value providers to specify must be a boolean provider, etc.)

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description condition Condition The condition to check. on_true Value Provider The value to provide if the condition returns true. on_false Value Provider The value to provide if the condition returns false.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:conditional",
    "condition": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:is_entity_of_type",
        "entity_type": "minecraft:creeper",
        "entity": "target"
    },
    "on_true": 100,
    "on_false": 0
}

This example is an int provider that provides $100$ if the entity provided by the neo-apoli:target_entity context parameter is a Creeper, or $0$ if they're not.

docs.title: Conditional Composite
docs.text:
Invokes and returns the value provided by an entry whose condition is fulfilled, or the specified default if no entries matched.

Type ID: neo-apoli:conditional/composite

Note

This meta type can only provide the same kind of value of the field where it was used. (e.g: if the field is a boolean provider, the value providers to specify must be a boolean provider, etc.)

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description entries Array of Entries The entries to check, invoke, and return the value of. default Value Provider The value to provide if none of the entries matched. Entry

An object that contains the condition to check and the value to provide.

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description condition Condition The condition to check. value Value Provider The value to provide if the condition is fulfilled.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:conditional/composite",
    "entries": [
        {
            "condition": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:is_entity_on_fire",
                "entity": "actor"
            },
            "value": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:world",
                "position": {
                    "type": "neo-apoli:entity/position",
                    "entity": "actor"
                }
            }
        },
        {
            "condition": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:is_entity_sneaking",
                "entity": "target"
            },
            "value": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:world",
                "position": {
                    "type": "neo-apoli:offset",
                    "vector": {
                        "type": "neo-apoli:entity/position",
                        "entity": "this"
                    },
                    "offset": [
                        0.0,
                        -1.0,
                        0.0
                    ]
                }
            }
        }
    ],
    "default": "example:fallback_block"
}

This example is a block provider which has two entries:

  • the first one provides the block at the feet of the entity provided by the neo-apoli:actor_entity context parameter if they're on fire
  • the second one provides the block below the entity provided by the neo-apoli:target_entity context parameter if they're sneaking.

If none of these entries fulfilled their condition, the block provided by the example:fallback_block context parameter will be provided instead.

docs.title: Weighted
docs.text:
Picks an entry at random and provides its value.

Type ID: neo-apoli:weighted

Note

This meta type can only provide the same kind of value of the field where it was used. (e.g: if the field is a boolean provider, the value providers to specify must be a boolean provider, etc.)

Note

The chance of an entry being picked is determined by dividing the weight of the entry to the sum of all the entries' weights.$(Chance = Weight_e \div (Weight_1 + Weight_2 + ... + Weight_n))$

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description entries Array of Weighted Entries The entries to pick a random entry from. Weighted Entry

An object that contains a value provider and its weight.

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description value Value Provider The value to provide. weight Integer The weight of the entry. The value must be either 0 or higher.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:weighted",
    "entries": [
        {
            "value": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:item/attribute",
                "attribute": "minecraft:armor",
                "item": "used_item"
            },
            "weight": 5
        },
        {
            "value": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:entity/attribute",
                "attribute": "minecraft:armor",
                "entity": "this"
            },
            "weight": 5
        },
        {
            "value": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:entity/fluid_height",
                "fluid_tag": "#minecraft:water",
                "entity": "this"
            },
            "weight": 1
        }
    ]
}

This example is a float provider that has three entries to pick from:

  • an entry that has 45% chance $(5 \div 11 = 0.45...)$ of providing the value of the minecraft:armor attribute from the item stack provided by the neo-apoli:used_item context parameter.
  • an entry that has a 45% chance $(5 \div 11 = 0.45...)$ of providing the value of the minecraft:armor attribute from the entity provided by the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter.
  • an entry that has a 9% chance $(1 \div 11 = 0.09...)$ of providing the height of the water fluid from the entity provided by the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter.

docs.text:
Joins all the specified strings into a single string and uses it as the provided value.

docs.text: Field Type Default Description strings Array of String Providers The strings to join together. separator String Provider The string to place between each string when joined.

    "type": "neo-apoli:join",
    "strings": [
        "tellraw @a {\"text\": \"",
        {
            "type": "neo-apoli:escape",
            "string": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:nbt",
                "source": {
                    "type": "neo-apoli:block",
                    "block": "used_block"
                },
                "path": "{}"
            }
        },
        "\", \"color\": \"gray\", \"italic\": true}"
    ],
    "separator": ""
}

This example joins three strings:

  1. A constant 'tellraw @a {"text": "' string.
  2. An escaped stringified NBT of the block provided by the neo-apoli:used_block context parameter.
  3. A constant '", "color": "gray", "italic": true}' string.
